product.name: Monoprice Essential Dual Monitor Articulating Arm Desk Mount
product.description: The Essential Dual Monitor Adjustable Arm Desk Mount is designed to mount two 13" ~ 27" displays weighing up to 17.6 lbs. each above your desk. The elevated display position not only adds space to your desk, but also improves your posture by allowing you to look straight ahead instead of downward. It also creates a neat and clean professional appearance, which improves the look of any home or office environment.
